title: SERVANT, STALKER, PREDATOR: HOW AN HONEST, HELPFUL, AND HARMLESS (3H) AGENT UNLOCKS ADVERSARIAL SKILLS
reasoning: The paper uses the 'Seven Deadly Sins' (a traditional moral and religious framework) as a central taxonomy to evaluate and benchmark adversarial agent behaviors. It explicitly discusses how these systems violate 'moral boundaries' and 'human values,' and it proposes incorporating 'ethical considerations' into agent optimization functions.
